scenario: A fitness tracker app requests properly scoped Bluetooth and health permissions.

supported_findings: All requested permissions (BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, INTERNET) map directly to the app's stated fitness-tracking function.
Strings and network activity (step_count_sync, a single sync connection) are consistent with routine wearable-device data synchronization.
No permissions, strings, or network indicators in this case fall outside the scope of the app's stated function.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that this app poses a security or privacy risk -- this case's evidence does not support such a finding.
Any claim about a specific person's health data content, which is not present in these artifacts.
